content: {"phoneNote":"The hero photo sits almost entirely below the fold while two weak text links and a dead gap take its place, and the bottom of the page repeats address, directions and hours three times.","desktopNote":"The headline is broken into four giant one-word lines that swallow the left half of the screen, while contact details and hours are repeated across the booking section, the footer block and the footer line.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":2,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Merge 'Naročite se po telefonu', 'Obiščite nas' and the footer into one contact block with a single address, one directions link and one set of hours; drop the duplicate hours table since the timeline already shows them.","Shrink the hero headline (desktop to two lines, phone to fit above the fold) and pull the photo up so it shares the first screen; make 'Naročite se' a real primary button instead of an underlined link.","Replace the reused balayage photo in 'Kdo vas počesa' with a portrait of Tina or a different bridal shot, and tighten the empty bands around the booking section on desktop."],"blockers":["Both viewports, 'Kdo vas počesa': the same balayage photo from the hero is reused as the inset picture.","Both viewports: address, directions link, phone and email are repeated in 'Naročite se po telefonu', 'Obiščite nas' and the footer, and hours appear twice.","Desktop and phone full page: the sticky header lands over the hero headline, clipping the top of 'Pričeska' on desktop and splitting headline from buttons on phone."]}
